scope: Official archive versus PCB and eight native footprint snapshots; not connectivity, DRC, CAM, assembly, impedance, or manufacturer-stack certification.

normalization.ticket_client: Highest ticket; equal ticket chooses lexicographically smaller DOCHEAD.client; equal ticket/client last record wins; tombstones applied.
normalization.numeric: Authored geometry/rules/stack: exact numeric equality only (1 equals1.0); boolean differs from number; no coordinate tolerance, rounding, or unit conversion. Derived POURED path representation differences are separately bounded and fully reported.
normalization.object_order: JSON object order ignored; list order, null/absent fields, all geometry/attribute bodies retained.

exact_default_representation_differences.reason: Runtime-added selector of the empty net, containing only the default length-tolerance binding.
Archive-only DEFAULT height rule with maxHeight=0; no physical/routing rule is discarded.

excluded_editor_record_types.CANVAS: Editor viewport, grid and editing origin preferences.
excluded_editor_record_types.PREFERENCE: Interactive routing/editing preferences, not persisted copper.
excluded_editor_record_types.META: Library/project document metadata; identity checked via DOCHEAD and footprint references.
excluded_editor_record_types.D3_ATTRIBUTE: 3D appearance/settings; not a replacement for LAYER_PHYS.
excluded_editor_record_types.SILK_OPTS: Editor silkscreen foreground/background color preferences; actual silk geometry is compared.

derived_pour_cache.scope: Only derived POURED recognized path numeric tokens permit explicitly reported coordinate differences of at most one ULP or ARC-angle differences at most 1e-10 degrees. Fill IDs, fields, topology, command order and stroke widths remain exact. Authored POUR definition/path/net/layer/rules and all physical geometry records remain exact. Cache comparison is not repour, DRC or actual-CAM copper proof.

footprint_scope_note: Footprint PAD/FILL/POLY/etc bodies, mask/paste expansions, pad numbers and ATTR records are compared exactly. Editor-generated footprint layer tables, board stack/rules and editor settings are not footprint geometry; board-owned rules/stack are separately checked on PCB.

physical_stack.raw_thickness_unit: mil; multiplied by0.0254 only for human-readable summaries, never for comparison
physical_stack.caution: Enabled copper layers do not prove a complete physical stack. Runtime-added/missing stack records are displayed, never normalized into PASS. No claim that the summed default thickness is the intended1.6mm manufacturer stack.
